selection_rule: For each zone and phase-shot status, select the chronologically earliest candidate from a fixture not yet selected if possible, otherwise the earliest available candidate. Never duplicate a corner. Preserve empty cells explicitly.
purpose: Six purposively selected examples for qualitative review, not a representative sample or an evaluation set
video_status: Not reviewed; no video source or video timestamps supplied
questions: Who makes the first visible contact, if the footage shows it?
Is an attacking receiver clearly in control after the delivery?
What observable movement, marking or goalkeeper action precedes the outcome?
Does the visible sequence agree with the logged endpoint and phase boundary?
